title: ライスシャワーからの提案

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We've been gathering members, and the team is really starting to take shape. One day…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I notice Rice Shower looking at me as if she wants to say something.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Well… I thought of something this morning…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rice Shower runs out of my office before I can stop her.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I, um, came up with a name for our team. I thought it might be poetic to compare ourselves to a blossoming flower, so, um…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I was thinking we could call ourselves "Blue Bloom." What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That might be a good team name! I'll have to make note of it.
